location: Inner Quest → Connect → Strengths in practice → My Reflections
headline: Ask what Inner Quest knows. Turn evidence into practice.
overview: Inner Quest MCP is valuable because it can retrieve the context that makes help personal, not because it can perform generic CRUD. This walkthrough connects securely, finds an official CliftonStrengths result with provenance, shows how the app turns those themes into testable practices, then creates one private reflection through MCP and finds the exact record in My Reflections.
targetAudience: People deciding whether a Personal OS gives an agent meaningfully better context

steps.title: Connection begins inside the private Personal OS
steps.action: Opened Inner Quest Connect and expanded the developer setup.
steps.description: The default path is install, connect and approve through OAuth. Inner Quest keeps refresh and disconnect controls in the product, while advanced endpoints remain available for other clients without making copied secrets the normal experience.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest Connect screen showing secure Codex connection controls and advanced developer setup

steps.title: The agent can retrieve an operating pattern, not just a profile card
steps.action: Queried the authenticated Personal OS for the owner profile and official CliftonStrengths evidence.
steps.description: The MCP response identified Arranger, Belief, Strategic, Achiever and Learner. The live app turns those themes into an operating pattern: coordinate moving parts around a meaningful outcome, then test that hypothesis against lived evidence instead of treating a personality label as destiny.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest Strengths in practice showing the Arranger and Belief operating pattern, top themes, leading domain and lived evidence

steps.title: Provenance keeps self knowledge honest
steps.action: Inspected the ranked themes and their source before using them.
steps.description: Inner Quest identifies this as the Gallup assessment completed on September 7, 2026, covering all 34 themes via a user-confirmed transcription. That source is kept distinct from an earlier partial archive, so an agent can tell official evidence from supporting notes.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest ranked strengths showing Gallup source, assessment date, all 34 themes and user-confirmed transcription
steps.location: Inner Quest → Strengths in practice → Results

steps.title: Inner Quest turns assessment labels into hypotheses to test
steps.action: Opened the generated strength combinations in the authenticated app.
steps.description: The product explicitly labels these as Inner Quest hypotheses, not claims copied from the assessment. Arranger plus Strategic becomes a question about coordinating change; Belief plus Achiever becomes a check that effort is producing a meaningful outcome.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest Strength combinations showing testable hypotheses for Arranger plus Strategic and Belief plus Achiever
steps.location: Inner Quest → Strengths in practice → Insights

steps.title: Insight becomes a private practice, not a static report
steps.action: Opened the guided experiment that asks what to rearrange, who must agree and how to learn from the result.
steps.description: The form can save a private reflection and optionally create a linked Action Item. This is the bridge from personality evidence to a decision, an experiment and a feedback loop inside the same Personal OS.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest guided strengths experiment with reflection prompts and a Save experiment button
steps.location: Inner Quest → Strengths in practice → Experiences

steps.title: A private MCP reflection appears in the real app
steps.action: Created one clearly labelled private reflection through the authenticated MCP connector, read it back three ways, then filtered My Reflections to the exact title.
steps.description: The prompt, practice and five supporting strengths arrive intact in My Reflections. The exact search filter excludes unrelated private records from the capture, and the synthetic proof record was removed after the walkthrough was verified.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest My Reflections showing the exact private strengths reflection created through MCP

keyFeatures: Strength combinations framed as testable hypotheses
Exact MCP read-back and visible app result
tips: Only official strengths evidence and the synthetic proof reflection appear in these captures; unrelated private Personal OS records are excluded.
note: Live-walked in the authenticated owner app and through the production Inner Quest MCP connector. One clearly labelled private reflection was created for proof, independently read back, captured in My Reflections, and removed after verification.
